description: Upstream source repository and registry page for every selected third-party parser path in data/<ecosystem>/<format>/parsers.json. Written by scripts/capture_upstream_repositories.py.
policy: Recorded repository facts first (parser record source fields, cell and project source locks, GitHub supplemental star capture, cell registry snapshot); registry metadata fetched only to fill gaps; a documentation URL on a code host is accepted last and only when the repository name matches the package. No URL is guessed: rows without an established repository have repository null and a repository_note. Recipe and port aggregators and Debian packaging repositories are never treated as upstream.
standard_apis: Standard and runtime APIs (data/<ecosystem>/<format>/standard.json) are not linked here; their records already carry official documentation URLs.
